lines.en: My footsteps land uneven, one deep one shallow.

lines.zh: 管子拖在身后，滴着胆汁。
lines.en: A tube drags behind me, dripping bile.

lines.zh: 我沿着实验台的方向走。
lines.en: I walk toward the lab benches.

lines.zh: 缝线被走路的动作扯紧了。
lines.en: Walking pulls my stitches tight.

lines.zh: 我这副身体有八个零件。
lines.en: This body of mine has eight spare parts.
These plates were welded on afterward.
Every three steps I change direction.
The floor is left with wet marks.
No rush; the trajectory needs distance.
Bile sloshes around inside my belly.
Shards of test tube still sit in my shoulder.
I swell a little with every step.
The corridor smells of nothing but potions.
Walk steady; do not spill any of it.

lines.zh: 我拖着管子走过烧焦的地板。
lines.en: I drag my tube across the scorched floor.

lines.zh: 每走一段，我就换个弹道角度。
lines.en: Every few steps, I change my firing angle.
I count the stitches across my belly.
My stomach bubbles like something boiling.

lines.zh: 我在检查出弹口有没有堵。
lines.en: I check whether my nozzle is clogged.
One cycle every three seconds, always on time.
I tap a finger against my armor plate.
The culture jar shattered long ago.
I remember the hands in the white coat.

lines.zh: 胆汁和酸液在轮流待命。
lines.en: Bile and acid take turns standing ready.

lines.zh: 我把流出来的液体抹回去。
lines.en: I wipe the leaking fluid back inside.
This body is too big to turn quickly.

lines.zh: 我在听自己喉咙里的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound inside my throat.
It itches, but I cannot reach it.
Standing still, my belly swells and sinks.
The experiment is not over yet.

lines.zh: 我把酸液晃匀了再站定。
lines.en: I slosh the acid even before I settle.
Something crawls beneath the stitches.

lines.zh: 你穿的衣服有点像白大褂。
lines.en: Your clothes look a little like a lab coat.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有带罐子。
lines.en: I check whether you carry a jar.
Your skin has no stitches in it.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像外面的空气。
lines.en: You smell like air from outside.

lines.zh: 你鞋底沾着实验室的灰。
lines.en: Lab dust clings to the soles of your boots.
Your eyes keep darting away.
Could you be an experiment too?
I tilt my head to one side and look.
There are no gloves on your hands.

lines.zh: 别把脸凑这么近，我看不清。
lines.en: Do not put your face so close; I cannot focus.
You are a bit taller than the culture jar.
Do not leave; I am not done looking.
You split one of my old seams open.
Fluid runs out of the opening.
This wound is not enough to drop me.
My plates are welded; they will not fall.
You hit a soft spot; cruel of you.
It hurts, but the bile burns hotter.
If a stitch snaps, I sew it again.
My acid is on your hands now.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，肚子还在响。
lines.en: I step back; my belly still rumbles.
Come on, try another cut.
What is inside that bottle of yours?

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我挪不动。
lines.en: The smell of potion roots me in place.
Give me one drop, just one drop.
That purple bottle looks familiar.
I know that fermentation smell.
Your gunpowder could trade for my acid.
My hand reaches toward your belt pouch.
Reagents! I can smell the reagents.
You sway the bottle; I sway with it.
I will not snatch it; I will trade.

lines.zh: 那罐东西还在你包里吧。
lines.en: That jar is still in your bag, yes?
I like sweet-tasting poison too.
Do not hide it; my nose is sharp.
Let me taste the experiment.

lines.zh: 你袖子上的药水渍还在。
lines.en: There is still a potion stain on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 那瓶绿的，和我肚子里一样。
lines.en: That green bottle matches what is in my belly.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，被我的甲弹开。
lines.en: You crash in and my armor bounces you off.
I am too heavy for you to shove.

lines.zh: 我的缝线差点被你撞开。
lines.en: Your impact nearly tore my stitches open.
Do not touch the tube; it holds acid.
Step back; I am about to vomit.

lines.zh: 你撞得我胆汁晃了一下。
lines.en: The bump makes my bile slosh once.
Your shoulder sinks into my soft parts.
Steady; do not step on my fragments.

lines.zh: 我的肚子撞你像一堵墙。
lines.en: My belly hits you like a wall.
One more bump and the bile comes first.

lines.zh: 另一个实验体也在找我。
lines.en: Another subject is looking for me too.
We share a single culture tube.
Your stitching is neater than mine.

lines.zh: 两只憎恶站在一起很挤。
lines.en: Two abominations standing together is crowded.
Trade half the bile; deal.
I recognize the number on your skin.
Come closer; do not mind my leaking.

lines.zh: 我们本来该在同一个罐里。
lines.en: We should have shared one jar originally.
Your acid is weaker than mine.
Let us wait together for the next experiment.
There is half a bottle of reagent on the floor.
I hold the bottle up against the light.
I push the broken glass aside first.
This iron can patch my armor.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进肚子上的口。
lines.en: I stuff it into the opening in my belly.
Abandoned samples belong to me.
I bend over slowly to pick things up.
The label on this bottle has rotted away.
I tighten the cap while I am at it.
Do not drop bottles in front of me.

lines.zh: 你的白大褂进了我的视野。
lines.en: Your lab coat has entered my sight.
I pick you because you can run.

lines.zh: 那个拿瓶子的是第一个。
lines.en: The one holding a bottle goes first.
You are standing on my firing line.
My belly is starting to heat up.
You carry old stitched scars.
The target moves in a very regular pattern.
I deal with the nearest one first.
You are backlit; easy to aim at.

lines.zh: 实验记录上该有你的名字。
lines.en: Your name belongs in the experiment log.
Bile bolt first, corrosive bolt after.

lines.zh: 我在等你走到两步之内。
lines.en: I wait for you to come within two steps.
The acid will stack layer upon layer.

lines.zh: 我把出弹口对准你胸口。
lines.en: I line my nozzle up with your chest.
Three seconds; when I finish counting, I fire.
You dodge left; I calculated that.
This shot is the green one.
I hold my breath and my belly shakes.
Your armor will not stop corrosion.
Half a step closer, and it is done.
I sweep my arm across at you.
Up close I actually get slower.
This punch comes with acid.
I pin you down on the lab bench.
I grab you by the collar.

lines.zh: 我的指节缝里全是胆汁。
lines.en: Bile fills the seams of my knuckles.
Little blisters rise on your skin.
Stop struggling; the stitches will snap.
Each blow adds another layer of acid.
You fell before I even fired.
The culture jar broke and I came out.
The number is still on my collarbone.

lines.zh: 醒来时我只看见绿色液体。
lines.en: I woke seeing nothing but green liquid.
The ones in white coats ran away.

lines.zh: 我从地上捡起自己的管子。
lines.en: I pick my own tube up off the floor.
My first breath is pure potion fumes.
This laboratory belongs to me now.
Subject seven is awake.
My two legs are not the same length.
Who pressed the activation switch?

lines.zh: 火烤着我的管子，味道很冲。
lines.en: Fire cooks my tubes and the smell is fierce.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，碎玻璃扎进背。
lines.en: I fall and broken glass digs into my back.

lines.zh: 水灌进管子，我咳出绿色。
lines.en: Water fills my tube and I cough green.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开我的半边肚子。
lines.en: The blast tears open half my belly.
An arrow sticks in my seam and wobbles.

lines.zh: 魔法把我体内的酸煮沸了。
lines.en: Magic boils the acid inside my body.
I hunger for reagents, not for meat.

lines.zh: 雷顺着管子烧到我肚里。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my tube into my belly.

lines.zh: 虚空没有重量，我飘得恶心。
lines.en: The void has no weight; floating makes me sick.
